parsed.claim: The ProperColoring definition is non-trivial: no function ℂ → Fin 1 is a proper coloring, because 0 and 1 are at unit distance. This is a sanity check on the definition only. It does not formalize the upper bound χ(ℝ²) ≤ 7, which is the half of Theorem 1.1 absent from the Lean statement, and a compile does not establish that bound.

theorem probe_one_color (c : ℂ → Fin 1) : ¬ OAI.EuclideanFiveColor.ProperColoring 1 c := by
  intro h
  have h1 := h 0 1 (by simp)
  exact h1 (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
